_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: The Open University BSc (Honours) Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence, qualification R88 (360 credits: open.ac.uk/courses/qualifications/r88 and open.ac.uk/courses/artificial-intelligence/degrees/bsc-computer-science-with-artificial-intelligence-r88, checked live 2026-09-27 and confirmed current, not superseded), cross-checked against the QAA Subject Benchmark Statement for Computing (published 2022-03, covering Computer Science)
_items_source.version: R88 module list and module pages as published on open.ac.uk, itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: This course's own stable ids (block.letter, e.g. 7a), grouped into 15 stages: 12 stages map one-to-one onto R88's 12 named 30/60-credit modules' principal topic strand, and 3 stages (9 Computer Systems and Architecture, 10 Computer Networks and Cybersecurity, 12 Human-Computer Interaction and Professional/Legal/Ethical/Social Issues) cover QAA-benchmark-mandated core Computing topic areas that sit inside R88's introductory modules' broader themes rather than forming a standalone R88 module of their own -- see material_vintage for exactly which is which. The OU's own internal unit-by-unit numbering within each module sits behind the student VLE and is not reproduced.
